brief: The revised Paper layout in six colour and font combinations. Same structure in all: opponent and rules at the top, scoresheet above the board, the board just above Undo / Rules / New, and an icon-only countdown (three dots, then a snail).

candidates.name: Paper
candidates.concept: Warm off-white, sand board, coral snails.
traits: One accent colour that only means snail
Board stays light enough for both piece colours

candidates.name: Mint & Graphite
candidates.concept: Cool white and graphite, a fresh green for the snails.
traits: One accent colour that only means snail
Board stays light enough for both piece colours
